mainEntity.name: What is the typical class structure for an indoor cycling session?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most indoor cycling classes at Cave Training follow a structured format designed to provide a comprehensive workout. Classes typically begin with a warm-up phase to prepare your muscles and cardiovascular system. This is followed by the main workout, which includes varied intervals of climbs, sprints, and steady-state efforts, guided by an instructor and music. The class concludes with a cool-down period and stretching to aid recovery. Our instructors carefully curate playlists and ride profiles to keep classes engaging and challenging, ensuring you leave feeling accomplished.
acceptedAnswer.description: Indoor cycling classes at Cave Training start with a warm-up, proceed through varied intervals of climbs and sprints, and conclude with a cool-down and stretching.
